name: @bridge/core
description: Bridge core: bridge.config.json, DTCG token loading (tiers and layered modes), alias resolution, WCAG contrast, diffs, minimal-diff edits, PR body, the shared risk tier classifier, changesets and a fetch-based GitHub client. No Figma API, no DOM; Node-only helpers (git, reading a product folder) under @bridge/core/node; the adoption audit under @bridge/core/audit.
